meta.title: AgentBridge — Terminal Command Execution & Authorization Workflow
meta.subtitle: Step-by-Step Validation, Policy Boundary, Confinement, Safe Process Supervision & Process Tree Cleanup
meta.description: Deterministic decision and execution workflow governing local terminal command requests in AgentBridge. Details working directory confinement, shell token rejection, PolicyEngine risk evaluation, CRITICAL operation protection, workspace locking, controlled environment construction, asynchronous supervision, output truncation, tree termination, and ActivityStore auditing.

states.label: Command Execution Request
states.description: Caller dispatches ConnectorRequest(operation='tool:execute', parameters={'executable': exe, 'args': [...], 'cwd': path, 'timeout': sec}).

states.label: Verify Connector READY State
states.description: Verifies connector is in READY status. If not, raises ConnectorNotConnectedError.

states.label: Validate Working Directory Confinement
states.description: Resolves canonical path, verifies directory exists, rejects filesystem roots, and verifies strict containment within authorized workspace roots.

states.label: CWD Valid & Confined?
states.description: Branch on working directory confinement. Rejects path traversal escapes outside workspace.

states.label: Reject with ConnectorInvalidRequestError
states.description: Invalid, non-existent, or unconfined directory rejected before any command inspection.

states.label: Validate Shell Safety & Argument Boundaries
states.description: Scans for forbidden chaining operators (; && || | > <), command substitutions ($() ``), and wrapper script invocations (bash -c, cmd /c, powershell -c).

states.label: Arguments Shell-Safe?
states.description: Branch on argument safety check. Rejects shell injection attempts and credential path targets.

states.label: Reject with ConnectorPermissionError
states.description: Shell injection tokens or sensitive credential path targets rejected immediately.

states.label: PolicyEngine Risk Evaluation
states.description: Assesses risk level (LOW/HIGH/CRITICAL). Evaluates CRITICAL patterns (git push --force, rm -rf), safe read-only queries (git status, python --version), and active session grants.

states.label: Authorized by Policy?
states.description: Branch on policy authorization. CRITICAL operations require single-use approval; mutating commands require grants.

states.label: Reject with ConnectorPermissionError (No Spawn)
states.description: Unauthorized command blocked at the policy boundary; child process is NEVER spawned.

states.label: Record Audit Start in ActivityStore
states.description: Persists tool call record with sanitized arguments, target cwd, and universal request_id.

states.label: Acquire Workspace Lock & Concurrency Slot
states.description: Acquires WorkspaceLockManager directory write lock (if requested) and acquires concurrency semaphore slot.

states.label: Spawn Native Subprocess (shell=False)
states.description: Constructs controlled environment stripping parent secrets and spawns child via asyncio.create_subprocess_exec.

states.label: Supervise Execution & Stream Output
states.description: Awaits child communication within bounded timeout cap, capturing stdout and stderr streams.

states.label: Execution Outcome?
states.description: Evaluate outcome: Success, Non-zero Exit, Timeout, or Task Cancellation.

states.label: Deep Process Tree Termination
states.description: Invokes kill_process_tree (taskkill /F /T on Windows, terminate -> kill on POSIX) to eliminate zombie processes.

states.label: Raise ConnectorTimeoutError
states.description: Command execution exceeded timeout threshold; process cleanly terminated.

states.label: Enforce Byte Caps & Centralized Redaction
states.description: Truncates streams exceeding max byte limits (sets truncated flag) and scrubs secret patterns from output.

states.label: Record Tool Call Completion & Release Locks
states.description: Updates ActivityStore record with duration and exit code, releases workspace lock and concurrency semaphore.

states.label: Return Structured ConnectorResult
states.description: Returns normalized ConnectorResult with exit code, sanitized content, structured_data, and duration metadata.
